ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels (dark grey/black) with approximately 5% high-intensity pixels (white) localized in discrete clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark pigmentation across the visible ventral plane with high-contrast white circular clusters (barnacle colonies) concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edge boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 40-degree V-shaped depression, vertex partially occluded by water turbulence and spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations characterized by jagged, non-uniform peaks and deep valleys (5-25 pixel depth) across both lobes, with significant disruption on the right trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve along the trailing edges transitioning into a sharp convex arc at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular pixel clusters (ranging 5-20 pixels in diameter) representing dense barnacle colonization, primarily located on the far left and right tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged irregular notches and tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe, departing from standard serration patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white-pixel encrustation along the outer perimeter of the fluke tips, creating a highly textured, high-contrast border against the dark fluke surface.
